units: SCADA samples (one multi-quantity connection-point sample each); protection checks (one protection or power quality check against its setting); busbar voltage deviation in % of nominal; transformer loading in % of rating

grains.RAW.SUBSTATIONS: one row per fictional grid connection substation (utility solar, onshore wind, nearshore wind, battery storage or solar-storage hybrid connection) in one of 6 Vietnam cities
grains.RAW.SUBSTATION_DAILY: one row per substation per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.EQUIPMENT_READINESS: one row per substation (inverter spare module, converter spare module, cable joint kit, battery cooling unit or power quality meter snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.grid_event_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(grid event in next 7 days) per substation, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide SCADA sample volume FORECAST; busbar voltage deviation ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.SUBSTATION_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic grid event response SOPs (one per connection type and cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.GRID_INTEGRATION_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.GRID_INTEGRATION_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, grid event, cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (KPIs, daily in-limit SCADA samples, grid events by substation, event risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
